_comment: Defaults for the autonomous layout generator (blender_agent/layout_gen.py).
scripts/layout_gen_run.sh and scripts/batch_generate.sh read this file when
the matching PANOWORLD_* environment variables are not set, so the whole
demo is reproducible with plain commands:
Rooms are drawn from the seed unless PANOWORLD_ROOMS / --rooms pins them.
1024x512 at 32 samples is the iteration profile: fast and ~0.6 GB peak.
Use 2048x1024 (the canonical PanoWorld size) plus 32 samples for a run
whose validation_report.json must pass every check including
canonical_resolution; it peaks near 1.9 GB, so renders stay serial.
